# Noota

> Noota is a European AI assistant for meetings, calls and email, founded in Paris in 2020. It records without a bot joining the call (desktop app, macOS and Windows), summarizes meetings, turns commitments into tasks and drafts email follow-ups. EU hosting (Google Cloud Belgium and Netherlands), optional sovereign environment (Scaleway, Bleu), ISO 27001 certified, SOC 2 Type 2 in progress, never trains AI on customer data.

Primary site: https://www.noota.io (its llms.txt: https://www.noota.io/llms.txt). These Markdown pages are plain-text mirrors with sources and verification dates; where they differ from the live site, the live site wins.

## About
- [About Noota: European Conversational AI Platform for Meetings, Calls & Email](https://docs.noota.io/about/noota.md): Learn about Noota SAS: European conversational AI founded in Paris in 2020. Bot-free meeting capture, EU sovereign data residency, and zero AI model training.

## FAQ
- [Noota FAQ: Frequently Asked Questions on AI Note-Taking, Privacy & Security](https://docs.noota.io/faq.md): Direct answers to top questions about Noota: bot-free capture, GDPR compliance, ISO 27001 certification, EU data residency, pricing, and integrations.

## Features
- [Noota AI Note-Taker: Bot-Free Meeting Recording & Intelligence](https://docs.noota.io/features/ai-note-taker.md): Record meetings discreetly on macOS and Windows with zero bot in the call. Delivers 50+ language transcription, automated minutes, and direct CRM sync.
- [Noota Email Automation & Mailbox Agent](https://docs.noota.io/features/email-automation.md): Connects to Gmail and Outlook to draft replies in your voice using meeting context, extract commitments into tasks, and streamline follow-ups.
- [Ask Noota: Cross-Meeting Knowledge Search & Organizational Memory](https://docs.noota.io/features/knowledge-management.md): Semantic cross-meeting search and AI intelligence. Ask questions across your company's entire audio, meeting, and email history to get sourced answers.
- [Noota Business Phone System: Native VoIP Calling & Call Intelligence](https://docs.noota.io/features/phone-calls.md): Native VoIP business phone system with local numbers in 30+ countries, automatic call transcription, AI summarization, and direct CRM logging.
- [Noota Talent: AI Recruitment Agent Suite & ATS Automation](https://docs.noota.io/features/recruitment-agent.md): Automated hiring intelligence: candidate sourcing across 800M+ profiles, outreach sequences, AI voice screening, interview scorecards, and ATS syncs.
- [Noota Supported Languages: 50+ Multilingual Audio Transcription & Translation](https://docs.noota.io/features/supported-languages.md): Noota provides native transcription across 50+ languages, bilingual code-switching support, multi-speaker diarization, and automated translation.
- [Noota Task System: Automated Commitment Extraction & Action Tracking](https://docs.noota.io/features/task-system.md): Automatically detects commitments made in meetings or emails, assigns owners and due dates, and synchronizes tasks into Notion, Slack, and CRMs.

## Security
- [Noota GDPR Compliance, Data Processing Agreement (DPA) & Sub-processor Registry](https://docs.noota.io/security/gdpr-and-data-processing.md): Comprehensive GDPR framework for Noota: Controller-to-Processor DPA, sub-processor directory, European data residency, zero-training AI policy, and Article 17 erasure workflows.
- [Noota Security: ISO 27001, EU Hosting and Data Protection](https://docs.noota.io/security/iso-27001-certification.md): Noota is ISO 27001 certified (SOC 2 Type 2 in progress), hosts EU data in Belgium and the Netherlands, never trains on customer data, and offers a sovereign environment.

## Pricing
- [Noota Pricing: Free, Pro, Business and Enterprise Plans](https://docs.noota.io/pricing/plans-and-tco.md): Noota pricing: Free, Pro (19 per user per month billed annually), Business (39 per user per month billed annually) and custom Enterprise.

## Solutions
- [Noota for Enterprise: European Sovereign AI Meeting Intelligence & Compliance](https://docs.noota.io/solutions/enterprise.md): Enterprise deployment specifications for Noota: sovereign hosting on Scaleway and Bleu (in the active ANSSI SecNumCloud qualification pipeline), ISO 27001 certified infrastructure, zero AI model training, SAML SSO, and SCIM provisioning.
- [Noota for Recruitment & Talent Acquisition: AI Interview Intelligence & ATS Automation](https://docs.noota.io/solutions/recruitment.md): AI interview notetaking, structured candidate scorecards as decision support, and two-way ATS sync for recruiting teams and executive search firms.
- [Noota for Sales Teams: Automated CRM Sync, MEDDIC Intelligence & Follow-Ups](https://docs.noota.io/solutions/sales.md): Sales meeting intelligence with bot-free call capture, automated MEDDIC/BANT opportunity logging in Salesforce and HubSpot, and instant follow-up email drafts.
- [Noota for Professional Services: Consulting, Legal & Advisory Practices](https://docs.noota.io/solutions/service-companies.md): Confidential meeting intelligence for management consultants, legal counsel, and advisory firms with bot-free recording, zero-training AI, and EU data residency.
